name: stockinfo
description: StockInfo provides stock and ETF quotes via a REST API (JSON), caches them in a SQLite database and refreshes them periodically. Backend (FastAPI) and dashboard (Vue) run in a single image on one port — the dashboard is served at the root URL, the API under /quote, /instruments, etc. Data sources: yfinance (Yahoo), justETF, OpenFIGI. Whatever the sources do not deliver can be entered by hand in the expandable detail area of a row — provider, replication, fund size, domicile, currency, TER, volatility and accumulating/distributing. The source always wins: a manual value fills a gap, it never overwrites, and it applies again as soon as the source goes quiet. Timezone: the "Timezone" setting (TZ) defaults to UTC — set it to your local zone for correct log timestamps. Valid values (TZ identifier column): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones OpenFIGI (optional): resolves an ISIN to the ticker at your preferred exchange (see "Default exchange"). It works without an API key, but only within OpenFIGI's low anonymous rate limit — once exceeded, resolution falls back to Yahoo search, which may return a different exchange or currency. A free key raises the limit and makes resolution reliable; enter it under "OpenFIGI API key". Register and create a key: https://www.openfigi.com/api

paths.name: Data (Cache DB)
paths.description: Persistent path for the SQLite cache DB (survives container updates).

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for dashboard + API (container listens internally on 8000).

variables.name: Refresh interval (hours)
variables.description: Interval of the periodic background refresh of all instruments.

variables.name: Cache TTL (hours)
variables.description: Age at which a quote is re-fetched on request.

variables.name: Metadata TTL (days)
variables.description: Refresh cycle for ETF metadata (TER, provider …).

variables.name: Default exchange (MIC)
variables.description: Preferred exchange (MIC) for ISIN lookups — worldwide. Examples: XETR (Xetra/EUR), XNAS (Nasdaq/USD), XNYS (NYSE/USD), XTSE (Toronto/CAD), XLON (London/GBp), XTKS (Tokyo/JPY), XASX (Sydney/AUD). The quote currency follows from the chosen exchange.

variables.name: Strict exchange
variables.description: If true, only the Default exchange is used — no Yahoo fallback. An ISIN with no listing there returns 404 instead of a substitute exchange/currency. Recommended for non-EUR instances that want honest "not available" over a wrong currency.

variables.name: FX rate TTL (hours)
variables.description: Age at which a foreign-exchange rate (GET /fx, used to convert mixed-currency portfolios) is re-fetched. FX moves continuously — keep this short.

variables.name: OpenFIGI API key
variables.description: Optional key for a higher OpenFIGI rate limit (empty = without).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone for log timestamps. Default UTC — set your local zone, e.g. Europe/Vienna or America/New_York.
